body:
Day 027 arrived in GitHub City Pages, after the archive had held its breath over a question: When does competence become a dangerous claim to rule? The streets of GitHub City Pages glimmered with the stored light of a prior decision. None of the stones could erase what had happened yesterday.

At the Emerald Library, Thoth opened the next blank leaf. The latest incident was recorded as a possibility inside their world: A painted lightning storm is mistaken for a storm beyond the page. This was the matter placed before Jupiter, though every member of the royal household had a stake in the answer.

Six hexads kept watch while the other one hundred and five rested beyond the library doors. In GitHub City Pages, a rendered road was visible, but a picture alone could not authorize a crossing.

Below the council, six of the 111 angelic hexads entered their single-cycle service. Their thirty-six bounded ballots favored the scroll of The City Of Two Skies. They did not inherit the power to decide what a person ought to believe; they offered the family competing possibilities.

The Skeptics asked whether the reported incident might admit another cause. The Witnesses traced the last recorded choice. Hera refused to let a successful service become a permanent throne. Zeus called the family together, and Jupiter and Mercury were permitted to disagree aloud.

The decision was to preserve the witnessed record before anyone crossed. Jupiter separates the rendered sky from the machinery keeping it visible. The result did not erase the preceding world: a witnessed seal gave the city an honest memory; Citizens preserve the beauty of their fiction without confusing it with the external world.

Zeus looked upon the square and said that speed was not the same as wisdom. Hera reminded the court that even kings must answer for a changed rule.

In the green light Thoth inscribed the consequence beneath the governing law PAGE. His seal described an authored fiction, not a discovered fact about the world outside the book. On the final margin of the scroll, he left one unresolved question: Can a rendered world be meaningful without pretending to be the entire world?

♃ ⚡︎⚡︎˖ ࣪⏻ᯤ The children carried the day into memory. The pages would render another dawn, but the future would be required to answer to this one.
